decisions.reason: This single-tube air fin cooler remains close to the core portfolio and aligned with demand for efficient heat-exchange equipment, so it is likely to stay in the range.
This air cooled condenser fits the firm's established engineering and service model, though some moderate portfolio-streamlining risk remains among similar condenser offerings.
This condenser is also core-adjacent and commercially sensible to retain, but overlap with nearby products gives it the highest consolidation risk in the group.
The liner for corroded heat exchanger tubes supports the installed-base repair and upgrade business, which is strategically valuable and typically sticky.
